title: Biomes O' Classic
description: This mod aims to bring back the cut content from Biomes O' Plenty
body: Biomes O' Classic resurrects the content cut from Biomes O' Plenty over the years. Rediscover the full gem set (amethyst, ruby, sapphire, peridot and more) as ores, blocks, tools, and armor. Build with mud, red rock, and skystone, grow loftwood trees, collect terrariums, flower bands, and scythes. Then the Promised Land, a radiant dimension of floating islands among the clouds. Every texture has been redrawn in the modern style by our team.
